claims.text: The company bet on cloud-security consolidation and identified AI-driven cloud adoption as a key demand driver for this strategy under Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian [Source: ev-1].
The deal signaled that major tech companies are aggressively pursuing consolidation in the cloud-security market. [Source: ev-1]
This was underscored by the transaction's scale—approximately $32 billion in an all-cash deal—and its status as the largest acquisition in Google’s history [Source: ev-1].

Additionally, the fact that Wiz had previously rejected Google's earlier $23 billion offer in July 2024 before agreeing to the higher price suggests significant competitive tension and high valuation standards within the sector during that period [Source: ev-1].
The agreement was announced on March 18, 2025, with completion reported in July 2025 after regulatory steps were completed [Source: ev-1].
